Hi Sarah — thanks for sending over the docs, I confirm we've received the W9 and bank letter.

Quick answers and next steps:
- We do micro-deposit verification for new payees. Originator name: Redwood Payments (you'll see deposits from "Redwood Payments" or reference RDW-PAY). Micro-deposits typically post within 1–3 business days depending on the vendor bank; please let us know once you see them and confirm amounts.
- For wires we typically capture the beneficiary address from the bank letter, but if your bank requires a beneficiary physical address field on the wire, please confirm the exact lines; otherwise the bank letter is sufficient.

I've looped in Jonas from Finance to provide the PO and confirm target payout date and remittance format.

Sarah — hi, Jonas on FinOps. Welcome aboard.

PO / payment details:
- PO: RDW-1739 (attached sample remittance: PO-1739-Remit.csv)
- Payment terms: NET 30 (unless otherwise negotiated)
- We will perform an ACH micro-deposit test from our originator account (Redwood Payments) on Mon, Apr 26. Expect two small deposits (random cents) — please confirm receipt and the exact amounts in reply to this thread.
- Once micro-deposits are validated we will schedule the initial settlement. Our earliest available window for a first bulk payout to new vendors is Fri, Apr 30 (end-of-day batch). If you need a wire instead, let us know — wires require a same-day cut-off and a small fee.

Remittance string expectations: single-line remittance that includes the PO and invoice number, e.g., "PO RDW-1739 / INV 4921 / Acadia Labs". Please confirm if your AP system parses a pipe or slash-delimited string.

I'll attach the remit csv with the expected columns for our lock step reconciliation.
